messages.author: Patricio German Barletta
messages.body:
Hi,
While I'm able to read ff19SB topologies and write them out as GROMACS '.top' files using parmed, I do wonder if this is correct.
I noticed open issues on the parmed github repo that said the CMAP terms of this force field were giving some trouble and I don't know if I should ask about it here, or on the parmed's repo.
I'd appreciate any help.
Thanks!
